**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

- **What exists:** §5.1(a) is a bare care-and-skill/qualified-personnel warranty; §5.1(b) is authority only; §5.1 closes with a compliance-with-laws covenant. There is no conformance warranty, no warranty duration anywhere, and no remedy (§11.1 is a Customer obligation; §12.2 maintenance is "as reasonably determined by IBM", not a warranty remedy).
- **What cuts against us:** §5.2 makes the §5.1 warranties exclusive and replaces implied warranties; §5.4 disclaims uninterrupted/error-free operation, capacity/performance/scalability, and puts all Materials and non-IBM software "AS IS" — close to walk-away territory.
- **Cure (fallback, one insertion into §5.1 as new (c)):** 90 days' conformance of the software portions of the Base Components to their documentation, 30 days for the Services, with repair, replacement or re-performance, or refund of fees paid for the non-conforming item.
- **Placement rationale:** drafted inside §5.1 so the §5.2 exclusivity carve is automatic, avoiding any broad "notwithstanding" override or collateral rewrite of §5.4's narrow disclaimers.
